character.name: Unnamed Character
character.description: You're fraggin' big, always have been fraggin' big. Too fraggin' big to mess with. Your sheer strength and size helped your family survive the hell of the Redmond Barrens, putting fools in their places. It got you drafted onto the Urban Brawl circuit and made you enough money to transition to your second career with a hell of a lot of serious cyberware. With your natural strength and size reinforced by cyberware and artillery, you're a force of destruction. You can take apart people or buildings with your massive fists or enormous cannons. You excel at what you do, you're paid well, and best of all, you enjoy it. Life is grand.
